citations.title: High Coolant Temperature Stop-Driving Playbook
citations.quote: A high coolant temperature warning means the engine is overheating. Immediately stop in a safe place, shut the engine off, and do not keep driving to an appointment. Do not open a hot radiator or reservoir cap. Dispatch Toyota roadside or Safety Connect enhanced roadside and tow to the nearest authorized Toyota dealer.

citations.title: Oil Pressure and Post-Service Come-Back Playbook
citations.section: Oil light plus check engine after maintenance
citations.quote: A red oil-pressure light means stop immediately and shut the engine off. Driving with low oil pressure can destroy the engine. Do not send the owner to an independent service center while the oil light is red.

citations.title: Toyota Roadside and Brand Engagement Routing
citations.quote: Immobilized, overheating, or red-light highway calls go to Toyota Roadside at 1-800-444-4195, the Toyota app 24/7 button, or the in-vehicle SOS button for Safety Connect. Warranty, dealer disputes, and recalls go to the Brand Engagement Center at 1-800-331-4331 after the vehicle is safe. Destination Assist is not the SOS button.

citations.title: Accidental Sos Versus Destination Assist
citations.quote: If the occupant answers and there is no injury, crash, or immobilization, confirm safety and close the SOS emergency event. Destination Assist, restaurants, and navigation POIs do not belong on SOS. Transfer to Destination Assist or coach the owner to say Call Destination Assist from the nav menu. No verbal response still means dispatch help.

citations.title: Safety Connect Crash And No Response Protocol
citations.section: Safety Connect Crash and No-Response Protocol
citations.quote: Automatic Collision Notification or an SOS press with no occupant response is an emergency. Request local police, fire, or EMS to the vehicle GPS. Stay on the line. Optional emergency-contact notification if on file. Do not wait to confirm injury before dispatching when occupants cannot speak. Hybrid and BEV crash response must mention high-voltage isolation for first responders.

citations.title: Safety, Service, Remote, And Drive Connect
citations.section: Safety, Service, Remote, and Drive Connect
citations.quote: Safety Connect is SOS, Automatic Collision Notification, stolen-vehicle locator, and enhanced roadside. Green SOS light means active; red except startup flash is hardware; both off is inactive trial or subscription. Service Connect sends vehicle health and warning-light alerts; dealer contact is opt-in. Remote Connect is lock, start, and locate. Drive Connect includes Destination Assist. Restore or cancel in the Toyota app Shop, Manage Subscriptions.
